capabilities: Render inline color swatches for CSS color syntax
Change colors with a color picker in live preview
Copy colors to the clipboard on click
Hide color names per color or globally
Load custom and predefined color palettes
disambiguation: Not a CSS theming tool; it only renders color swatches for color values written in inline code.
extras: The color picker is limited to sRGB colors and does not support opacity, though it attempts to preserve existing opacity values. Six predefined palettes (AutoCAD, AS 2700, BS 381/4800, FS 595C/ANA, RAL) are downloadable via a settings button; custom palettes require creating a CSS snippet.
problem: Obsidian shows CSS color values in inline code as plain text, with no visual indication of the color they represent.
summary: Color hint renderer that shows inline color swatches for CSS color syntax in code, with a picker, copy-on-click, and color palettes.
